SESSION	create temporary view stuff as select * from values
READ	SELECT 100 * SUM(i) + SUM(f) / COUNT(s) AS f1, i AS f2 FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY f2
READ	SELECT i + 1 AS i1, COUNT(i - 2) ci, f / i AS fi, SUM(i + f) sif FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, 3
READ	SELECT i AS i, COUNT(i) ci, f AS f, SUM(i + f) sif FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1, i, 2, ci, 3, f, 4, sif
READ	SELECT i + 1, f / i, substring(s, 2, 3), extract(year from t), octet_length(d), size(a) FROM stuff
READ	SELECT i + SUM(f) FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL
READ	SELECT s AS s, COUNT(*) c FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL HAVING SUM(f) > 0 ORDER BY s
READ	SELECT SUM(i) si FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL HAVING si > 2
READ	SELECT SUM(i) si FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL HAVING si < 2
READ	SELECT SUM(i) si FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL HAVING i > 2
READ	SELECT SUM(i) si FROM stuff GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY i DESC
